newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stock market edges fraction higher.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stock market edges fraction higher.

text.p: Qatar's unofficial stock market edged a fraction higher in the week to Thursday, taking a breather after a steady advance of several months, brokers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's (CBQ) 18-share index crept up 0.18 points to 121.73 from 121.55 points a week earlier.
"The market saw activity in some shares but in general the dealing was rather subdued," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, senior investment manager at the CBQ.
During the week, six shares moved up slightly and 12 were unchanged.
Doha Bank Ltd picked up two riyals to 277 and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar gained one riyal to 215.
Qatar Navigation advanced three riyals to 713 and Qatar Cement inched up one riyal to 304.
Qatar Cinema added one riyal to close at 178 and Qatar Shipping moved up half a riyal to 48.50.
